title: Cloudflare Workers vs Vercel Functions for web app backends
meta_description: Cloudflare Workers vs Vercel Functions: documented workflows, constraints, fit, and primary-source decision guidance for a considered choice.
intro: This source-backed comparison addresses the observed query pattern “Cloudflare Workers vs Vercel Functions” for web application teams selecting a serverless backend runtime. It compares stable, documented workflows and constraints rather than volatile prices, inventory, ratings, or reviews.
verdict: Choose Cloudflare Workers when the documented edge-runtime model and platform bindings fit the application. Choose Vercel Functions when the application is already organized around Vercel deployment workflows. Validate runtime compatibility, locations, limits, and data dependencies with the current provider documentation.
